name: Sword and Starfall
source:
Welcome to the lone moon of Celesia, enjoy your stay...

The moon is inhabited by a wide range of anthro and non anthro creatures, almost all of which possess strange magical powers. 

Embark on a journey through this mysterious land, meeting new people and gaining a deeper understanding of how you ended up in this place, and what you need to do to save it from its impending doom.

After waking up in a world different from your own, you must explore not only your new surroundings but yourself, dealing with your new appearance and abilities, and who knows, maybe you'll meet a love interest along the way.

[From [url=https://damienredpaw.itch.io/sword-and-starfall]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到塞莱西亚的孤独之月，祝你住宿愉快……

月球上居住着各种各样的人类和非人类生物，几乎所有这些生物都拥有奇怪的魔法力量。

踏上穿越这片神秘土地的旅程，结识新朋友，更深入地了解你是如何来到这个地方的，以及你需要做什么才能将它从即将到来的厄运中拯救出来。

在一个与自己不同的世界中醒来后，你不仅要探索新的环境，还要探索自己，处理你的新外表和能力，谁知道呢，也许你会在路上遇到一个爱人。

[来自[url=https://damienredpaw.itch.io/sword-and-starfall]Itch.io[/url]]
